title: Paginate API results
prompt:
Implement `paginate(items, page, size)` in src/paginate.js for the orders API: pages start at 1; it returns
`{ items, page, size, total, pages }` where `pages` is at least 1 (an empty list has one empty page). `page` and `size`
may arrive as strings from the query string; they must be positive integers (size at most 100), otherwise it throws a
`RangeError`. A page past the last returns an empty `items` with the real `pages`.
